name: How do Denver-area soil and climate conditions affect basement trim installation?

mainEntity.name: How do Denver-area soil and climate conditions affect basement trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, soil movement and dry indoor winter air create distinct shifting, making flexible finish details essential. Basements often use floating interior walls to accommodate bentonite clay soil expansion. Trim work must respect these intentional movement gaps so walls can adjust without cracking or buckling trim joints. Combining proper baseboard sizing with flexible, paintable acrylic latex caulk ensures clean transitions that can withstand seasonal indoor humidity swings between summer and winter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expansive soils and dry winters require trim to accommodate floating wall designs, paired with flexible caulking to absorb seasonal movement without cracking.
